enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.filte: Shortens harmful effect durations while extending beneficial ones.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.insig: Increases looting level scaling with total armor enchantability.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.dexte: Prevents underwater mining slowdown and increases reach distance with tools.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.vital: Increases maximum health and healing effectiveness.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.adapt: Gradually increases resistance when taking damage of the same type. Resets when taking damage from a different type.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.barri: Grants a barrier which limits incoming damage. Recharges over time.
Increases damage resistance while at or below half health. Effect increased while sprinting.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.scave: Loot drops are pulled to the wearer and temporarily boost armor toughness.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.stabi: Reduces knockback and prevents explosions from breaking nearby blocks.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.agili: Improves overall mobility, bonus increased while any movement status boosts are active.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.frict: Allows sliding down and jumping off walls for a short duration.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.tempe: Negates durability loss when mining natural non-resource blocks.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.excav: Allows the tool to mine in a 3x3 radius.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.harve: Harvested crops are automatically replanted and have their yield increased.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.power: Arrows can be overcharged, significantly increasing damage and knockback.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.barra: Significantly increases bow draw speed and returns hit arrows.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.volle: Hitting a target automatically reloads the crossbow.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.grapp: Increases reeling strength. Reeling while the bobber is attached to a block pulls the user towards it.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.deep_: Cooks caught fish and sets reeled targets on fire.
enchantment.brokensenchantoverhaul.black: Removes durability loss. Smash attack kills repair a random equipped item.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: Chance to reflect a portion of damage taken. Effect increased while at or below half health.
enchantment.minecraft.swift_sneak.desc: Increases sneaking speed and reduces monster awareness radius.
enchantment.minecraft.depth_strider.desc: Increases movement speed in water and allows use of water specific effects on land.
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: Increases movement speed on soul-infused blocks or while at or below a quarter health.
enchantment.minecraft.sweeping_edge.desc: Enables sweeping attacks which deal extra damage for each target hit.
enchantment.minecraft.smite.desc: Attacks deal extra damage to undead and targets with negative status effects.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_aspect.desc: Attacks ignite targets, with consecutive hits increasing burn damage.
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc: Attacks deal increased damage to targets in water or rain.
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: Thrown tridents summon lightning on impact if the sky is visible.
enchantment.minecraft.breach.desc: Smash attacks temporarily boost armor piercing and attack speed.
enchantment.minecraft.flame.desc: Arrows set targets on fire, with consecutive hits increasing burn damage.
enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de: Increases chance of treasure drops and fishing speed.
